# swarmops diff

List the files that differ between two revisions, a page at a time.

```yaml
title: "swarmops diff"
description: "List the files that differ between two revisions, a page at a time."
group: "read"
since: "0.1.0"
mutates: false
identity_required: false
mcp_tool: "diff"
envelope_op: "diff"
exit_codes: [0, 2, 6]
errors: [E_REV_NOT_FOUND, E_INVALID_ARG]
syntax: "swarmops diff [OPTIONS] <FROM> <TO>"
```

## Syntax

```text
swarmops diff [OPTIONS] <FROM> <TO>
```

## Required arguments

### `FROM`

Syntax: `<FROM>`.

The revision to diff from.

### `TO`

Syntax: `<TO>`.

The revision to diff to.

## Optional arguments

The command also takes the [global options](../cli.md#global-options).

### `--path`

Syntax: `--path <P>...`.

Only the files at or below this path; give it again for more.

### `--format`

Syntax: `--format <FORMAT>`.
Default: `names`.

What to say of each file. Values: `names`: Its path and status; `stat`: Also whether it is binary and, for text, the lines it inserts and deletes; `unified`: Also its kinds, its blobs and, for text, its hunks.

### `--context`

Syntax: `--context <N>`.
Default: `3`.

The unchanged lines around each change in a unified hunk.

### `--limit`

Syntax: `--limit <N>`.
Default: `500`.

The most files to list.

### `--cursor`

Syntax: `--cursor <CURSOR>`.

Resume a diff: the previous page's cursor, exactly as it was returned.

### `--max-bytes`

Syntax: `--max-bytes <N>`.
Default: `32768`.

The most bytes of a unified page's files, as JSON (the first file comes all the same, its hunks cut to fit).

## Examples

### CLI

```sh
swarmops --repo [tmp]/store diff [c1] [c2]
```

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "op": "diff",
  "api": 1,
  "result": {
    "from": "[c1]",
    "to": "[c2]",
    "files": [
      {
        "path": "README.md",
        "status": "modified"
      },
      {
        "path": "bin/run",
        "status": "modified"
      },
      {
        "path": "latest",
        "status": "type_changed"
      },
      {
        "path": "logo.bin",
        "status": "modified"
      },
      {
        "path": "notes.txt",
        "status": "deleted"
      },
      {
        "path": "src/lib.rs",
        "status": "added"
      }
    ],
    "truncated": false
  },
  "meta": {
    "repo": "[tmp]/store",
    "elapsed_ms": "[elapsed_ms]",
    "resolved": {
      "[c1]": "[c1]",
      "[c2]": "[c2]"
    },
    "auth": "trust"
  }
}
```

Exit code 0. Recorded by the CLI tests. A name in square brackets, such as `[tmp]` or `[c1]`, stands for what differs from run to run: the test's temporary directory, an id, a time.

## Return information

`result` is a `Diff` (`swarmops schema Diff` prints its JSON Schema).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | `string or null` | no | When `truncated`: where the next page starts. Opaque: pass it back as given, as the next request's `cursor`. |
| `files` | `array of FileDiff` | yes | The files. |
| `from` | `string` | yes | The changeset `from` named. |
| `to` | `string` | yes | The changeset `to` named. |
| `truncated` | `boolean` | yes | Whether more files follow this page. |

Envelope `op`: `diff`.

Exit codes:

- `0`: Success.
- `2`: The request or the command line is malformed.
- `6`: Something the request names does not exist.

## Errors

- [`E_REV_NOT_FOUND`](../errors.md#e_rev_not_found) (exit 6): A revision names no changeset.
- [`E_INVALID_ARG`](../errors.md#e_invalid_arg) (exit 2): A malformed argument or request, including a command-line usage error.

Any command that opens a store may also fail with a store error, such as [`E_NOT_A_REPO`](../errors.md#e_not_a_repo), [`E_IO`](../errors.md#e_io) or [`E_STORE_CORRUPT`](../errors.md#e_store_corrupt); a command line the grammar refuses is [`E_INVALID_ARG`](../errors.md#e_invalid_arg) (exit 2).
